cards.label: Later
cards.text: You come round on the floor. Your ore is gone. The window is open. The rest of the place looks ransacked, though in hindsight it isn't too dissimilar to how it was before; you should probably tidy up a bit more often.
Archie arrives at seven in the morning. He takes one look at you and puts the coffees down without saying anything for a moment.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Yeah." He sits down. "You alright, though? Properly?"

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Good. You fought back, and that counts. I've worked with people who'd have handed it over." He pauses. "Some of them were me, early on."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "But this place is a liability. One lock, a window that doesn't close. It's a service entrance."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "You need to move. Somewhere with a proper door. That means a deposit, and a deposit means cash. Rent first, obviously. Then the deposit."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "I'll line you up some help. Des. Best prospector I know, and he's got a use for you. Don't mention the twenty quid."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Partners, while I'm here. Security bloke, reasonable price, no paperwork. And the vein I promised: time, Whitechapel. Yours. It needs work before it pays."
He stays until you've eaten something, which you didn't ask for and didn't expect. Then he leaves. You check your phone. There's a pin location. The vein.
